name: Groupe Renaissance du Nord
tagline: Creating a brighter future for all: honestly, respectfully, sustainably and transparently.
about:
Welcome to Groupe Renaissance du Nord, a non-governmental organization dedicated to creating a brighter future for all. Our six main pillars focus on education, environmental protection, social housing, disability support, health and wellness, and poverty alleviation. We believe in doing things differently - honestly, respectfully, sustainably, and transparently.
At Groupe Renaissance du Nord, we are passionate about making a positive impact on society. We believe that education is the foundation of a prosperous and equitable society, and we provide resources and support to underprivileged children to ensure they have the opportunity to learn and grow. We also advocate for policies that promote access to quality education for all children, regardless of their socioeconomic status.
We recognize that the health of our planet is essential to our collective well-being, and we are committed to protecting and conserving the environment. Our organization raises awareness about environmental issues and promotes sustainable practices. We engage in initiatives to reduce our carbon footprint and minimize our impact on the natural world.
Social housing is another key focus of our work. We believe that everyone deserves a safe and affordable place to call home, and we work to provide housing options for those who are most in need. Our organization collaborates with other groups to offer job training, financial education, and other resources that help families achieve long-term stability.
We are also dedicated to supporting people with disabilities. Our organization promotes inclusion and advocates for policies that advance the rights of people with disabilities. We provide resources and opportunities to help individuals with disabilities live fulfilling lives.
Finally, we believe that health and wellness are essential to a thriving society. Our organization offers a range of initiatives, including health fairs, workshops, and educational programs, to promote healthy living and prevent illness. We support sustainable means of poverty alleviation, such as microfinance programs, to help individuals and families build their own businesses and achieve financial independence.
Join us on our mission to create a more equitable, sustainable, and just world for all. Together, we can build a brighter future for ourselves and future generations.
president_message:
Dear friends and members,
It is an honour and privilege for me as the maiden President of Groupe Renaissance du Nord (GRDN) to showcase to you a souvenir magazine marking our 1st anniversary portraying all the different numerous activities we have organised throughout the past year. It is an occasion for us to acknowledge the devotion, seriousness, hard work, love and above all unquestionable trust you all shower on us. It is very rare for a newborn group and we immensely treasure that special relationship.
Groupe Renaissance du Nord was officially launched on 30th January 2022 as an NGO aiming to do things differently but in an honest, truthful, respectful and transparent manner. Our mission revolves around six main pillars namely Education of needy children, Environment Protection & Conservation, Social Housing for the deprived, supporting people with disabilities, Health Promotion & Wellness and Poverty alleviation through sustainable means. We are proud to say that during our 1st year of existence, we successfully covered all of our objectives by organising no less than 22 events all year long reaching almost all spheres of our Rainbow nation.
Construction of a concrete house for Mrs Antoinette of Cité EDC Pamplemousses, early opening of Pamplemousses Botanical Garden for jogging/walking and collection of abandoned statues of different idols and properly disposing them in a dignified manner are among many of the star projects we have achieved altogether. These achievements undoubtedly are the fruits of the dedication and unconditional support of all members. I seize this opportunity to earmark the enormous financial contributions of our members who have relentlessly provided their own funds for the smooth and timely execution of our projects such as the construction of Mrs Antoinette’s house.
As we continue to navigate the aftermath of Covid-19 and the war in Ukraine, we understand fully that the coming days will not be easy nevertheless with our determination and your unconditional support we look forward to tackling the numerous complex challenges facing our society. We also wish to seek collaboration and are open to joint ventures with other NGOs sharing the same vision and philosophy in whatever manner for the betterment of one and all. We also welcome people of all age groups wishing to help us, especially the youngsters investing more energy in social reality than social media. In the months moving forward, as we plan for the future, we will continue to explore what our community needs from us while adapting to the changes all around us.
Finally, we wish to express a big note of appreciation, gratitude and thank our generous sponsors, concerned donors, committed volunteers, dedicated media partners and all well-wishers. None of our proud achievements would have been possible without your unwavering support. Your love and trust kept us moving forward all the way.
